headline: Gold rebounds ₹152 a gram today; silver flat at ₹1,65,000 a kg
summary: Gold 24K rose ₹152 per gram today (about 1.23%) to ₹12,480, recovering from the lowest level in the last 32 days reached on 25 November. Against seven days ago, gold is still down ₹589 per gram (about 4.51%), and over the full 32-day span it is down about 12.57%. Silver was unchanged today at ₹1,65,000 per kg, but it is 8.33% lower than seven days ago and about 25% below its 26 October level. Possible drivers include the US dollar and rupee movements and international prices, though this is not a forecast.
outlook: Today's bounce is a single-day move after a sharp fall, so it may be worth comparing rates across shops and waiting a few days before large purchases, keeping in mind that GST and making charges apply on top.
